meta.title: Coaching for endurance athletes
meta.description: Individual and online coaching for running, cycling, cross-country skiing and ski mountaineering, built on your lab results and training data.

hero.title: Training built around you.
hero.subtitle: Science, experience and consistent tracking of your progress, combined in one system.

individual.title: Individual coaching
individual.text: A plan fitted to your goal, your daily routine and your current fitness.

online.title: Online coaching
online.text: Weekly planning, adjustments along the way and ongoing contact, wherever you live.

racePrep.title: Race preparation
racePrep.text: Season periodisation, peaking at the right time and tactics for your key races.

watchData.title: Watch data analysis
watchData.text: Interpreting the training load, heart rate and recovery data from your Garmin or other sports watch.

progressReview.title: Progress review
progressReview.text: A look back at your training and the long-term trends in your progress.

mental.title: Mental preparation
mental.text: Working on motivation, focus and handling race pressure.

biomechanics.title: Biomechanics
biomechanics.text: Analysis of your technique and movement patterns, for more efficiency and fewer injuries.

physiology.title: Physiology
physiology.text: Training zones, the aerobic threshold and endurance development on a scientific basis.

packages.title: Packages
packages.subtitle: Three levels of support. Pick the one that fits your goal.

labTestFirst.question: Do I need a lab test first?
labTestFirst.answer: It isn't required, but it's the best start. Training zones from your own lactate or VO₂max test are more accurate than any estimate, and your plan is built on them.

devices.question: Which watch do I need?
devices.answer: Any watch or bike computer that can export workout files (.FIT, .TCX or .GPX), such as Garmin, COROS, Polar, Suunto or Wahoo. You upload your workouts; no special connection is needed.

minimumTerm.question: Is there a minimum term?
minimumTerm.answer: Coaching and Elite run for at least 3 months. Plan has no minimum term.

yearly.question: Can I pay for a year?
yearly.answer: Yes. Pay for a year up front and you get 2 months free.

messages.question: Who answers my messages?
messages.answer: Your coach. Messages are always answered by a person: within 72 hours on Plan, 48 hours on Coaching and 24 hours on Elite.

cta.title: Not sure which package fits?
cta.text: Write to me with your goal and I'll suggest where to start.
